sentences.en: He wasn't about to believe Death until he saw Katie for himself.  A minute after midnight on the fourth day, if Katie wasn't standing beside him, he'd need the knowledge of where to set off the atomic bomb within him.

sentences.en: Such uranium centrifuges appear to be key to North Korea's revived nuclear bomb program.
